q: How does hash sharding pick an owner?
a: Key mod shard count, with no lookup or coordinator on the read path.
Skewed keys pile onto one shard until it saturates and drops while siblings idle.

q: Why doesn't adding shards always fix a hot shard?
a: It only helps if new keys land on the new shards; a single celebrity key follows its hash.

q: What should you watch instead of fleet totals?
a: Per-shard load: totals hide a burning shard behind idle siblings.
